bio.text: Ed Case has represented Hawaii's First Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2019; he previously represented Hawaii's Second District from 2002 to 2007.
He served in the Hawai'i State House from 1994 to 2002, including as Majority Leader, and practiced law in Honolulu for over two decades.
He later worked as Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer of Outrigger Enterprises Group.
Case was born and raised in Hilo and attended Williams College and the University of California College of the Law, San Francisco.
